ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 40% high-intensity (white) pixels in distal regions vs 60% low-intensity (black/grey) pixels in the central and marginal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central and basal fluke regions are characterized by a large, contiguous low-intensity black mass. Distal lobes contain high-intensity white expanses. The right lobe specifically exhibits a dense cluster of small, low-intensity stippled blobs on the white background field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; approximate pixel angle of 65 degrees. The depth of the notch extends roughly 20-25% into the vertical height of the visible lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the right trailing edge with approximately 12-15 distinct pixel peaks. Left trailing edge shows similar irregular topography with moderate pixel-amplitude variation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curve trajectory fitted from the median notch apex toward the distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized dark, roughly circular pixel cluster located on the white field near the extreme right distal tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of several distinct, dark linear pixel disruptions (parallel rake marks) on the lower-right white quadrant of the fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible rake marks on the right lobe; highly irregular jagged indentation/trauma on the upper-right corner of the trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique, non-symmetrical jagged protrusion on the far right trailing edge tip that deviates from the standard serration frequency.
